decisions.summary: A tie goes to the standard's order.

Hand-sheet obstacle rules: inner ink avoided, a ground's border is ink, dark ink heavier, a fill painted after a caption weighs as text, a room's containing building waived for that room's area caption; round 4: a caption's own partitions now weigh in full, and an area caption keeps off the drawn outline of its area and of the building holding it.
decisions.why: The round-4 rules each ADD weight where a seat was cheaper before (the outline bands are obstacles; the partitions went from light to full), so neither can drop or loosen a caption; FR-006's free-beats-covered rule and FR-007's never-drop rule are untouched, and seat-label reports 0 off seat under them. The one loosening, the containing building waived, stays physically forced by 266 FR-008 (an area caption lies inside its area).

decisions.why: A measurement correction: 266 FR-002 gives the placer the caption's text and size, and a block measured at the wrong size is the wrong subject. Unit-tested (test_a_sub_line_is_measured_at_its_own_size).
